# Local XREAL package

Place the vendor download here as `com.xreal.xr.tgz`.

It is intentionally excluded from Git. Download **XREAL SDK for Unity 3.1.0** from the official XREAL developer portal and ensure the filename is exactly `com.xreal.xr.tgz`; Unity Package Manager will then resolve the `com.xreal.xr` dependency declared in `../manifest.json`.
